summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026) with hands-on embedded systems experience across STM32, Raspberry Pi, and NVIDIA Jetson. Proficient in bare-metal C/C++, FreeRTOS, and hardware integration over UART, I2C, and SPI; verified with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented UART and I2C sensor communication with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member team across national-level competitions owning PCB fabrication, mechanical design, and firmware integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove: ADXL345 accelerometers on Raspberry Pi with HC-05 Bluetooth translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands.
Implemented z-axis differential tap-detection; resolved sensor jitter via software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a Python/PyQt GUI for real-time laboratory data acquisition; used GitLab for version control and collaborative documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal C: timer-triggered ADC scan, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at 1 Hz deterministic rate.
Programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, and I2C1 directly without HAL; verified in Proteus simulation.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination across YOLO detection (Jetson) and STM32 servo control over UART; interrupt-driven command handling with multi-servo PWM and VL53L0X ToF sensing.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with contact-aware grasping via dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over TCA9548A I2C mux; resolved 11 integration failures to achieve 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Achieved 5.2× inference speedup (56.7 → 10.9 ms) via TensorRT-optimized YOLO on Jetson for real-time visual servoing at ~11.5 s end-to-end latency.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
